generation_parents.algorithm: Score each feasible customer by a weighted combination of proximity to the current node and urgency based on demand relative to remaining capacity, choosing the minimum.

Design a regret-based insertion heuristic that scores each feasible next customer by the increase in route distance relative to returning to the depot, then selects the customer minimizing this adjusted cost so short trips are avoided and better-aligned customers are prioritized.

generation_parents.algorithm: Score each feasible customer by the angular deviation between the incoming direction (depot/current node vector) and the outgoing direction to the candidate, penalized by distance and reward for high demand, selecting the minimum to keep routes spatially coherent and capacity-efficient.
